articles.summary: How to ensure reliable state-of-charge estimation for utility-scale BESS? Accurate State-of-Charge (SOC) estimation is essential for reliable BESS operation. However, battery behaviour, particularly in LFP batteries, can make SOC estimates difficult to trust under real operating conditions. This white paper explores the challenges of SOC estimation, how physics-based models improve…
articles.title: Reliable state-of-charge estimation for utility-scale BESS
